settings.quote: I work from the couch three days a week now. Six height settings means it's perfect for my laptop and my lunch plate. Took two minutes to set up, no tools.
settings.author: Sarah T.

settings.quote: Bought the Executive for my dad after his knee surgery — the footrest is genuinely brilliant and the cup holder means his tea doesn't end up on the carpet anymore.
settings.author: Michael R.

settings.quote: Great for gaming nights — angled setting is perfect for the controller and the tray doesn't wobble even with a monitor on it.
settings.author: Priya K.

settings.quote: Folds completely flat and slides behind the couch. My apartment is tiny so this mattered more than anything else — genuinely space-saving.
settings.author: Josh L.

settings.quote: Ordered the Smart in sky blue for my daughter's room — she does her homework on it every afternoon now instead of lying on the bed.
settings.author: Amanda F.

settings.quote: Best purchase for our small apartment. Folds up in seconds and fits behind the door.
settings.author: Chen W.
